tools.name: discover_supply
tools.description: Find existing supply by service and area. Ask only for missing details returned as needs_input. Explicit browse=countries lists A–Z countries and no counts; browse=services or markets supports browsing. No new search.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Read current providers and profiles from a discovered service page. No phone numbers.

tools.name: prepare_message
tools.description: Only when the user explicitly asks to message a chosen provider, prepare a Big Red profile link carrying their draft; its Message button uses the normal WhatsApp/referral flow. Present the returned labelled Markdown link directly; never print the raw encoded URL. Keep the reply short. No contact rev
